segments.he: אֲפִילּוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ שׁוֹאֵל בִּשְׁלוֹמוֹ לֹא יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ.
segments.en: Additionally, we learned in the mishna: «Even» if «the king greets him» while he is praying, «he should not respond to him» as one may not interrupt his prayer.

moves.cueHe: אפילו המלך שואל בשלומו לא ישיבנו
moves.summary: re-cites the mishna's clause on not answering even a king during prayer
moves.about: the mishna's clause that one may not answer even a king's greeting during prayer
